description: This file defines the Swing UI class HonoSenderSamplerUI for configuring and creating instances of the HonoSenderSampler, which is a JMeter test element. It provides user interface components for inputting parameters related to sending messages via Hono endpoint, such as tenant, device ID, message content, and timing options.

classes.name: HonoSenderSamplerUI
classes.description: Swing UI component for configuring the HonoSenderSampler test element in JMeter. Provides input fields and options related to message sending parameters.

methods.name: HonoSenderSamplerUI
methods.description: Constructor that initializes UI components and layout for the sampler settings.

methods.name: getStaticLabel
methods.description: Returns the static label for this UI component, used in JMeter GUI.

methods.name: createTestElement
methods.description: Creates and returns a new HonoSenderSampler test element, applying the current UI configuration.

methods.name: modifyTestElement
methods.description: Populates a given test element with settings from the UI.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the UI fields based on a given test element.

methods.name: clearGui
methods.description: Resets UI components to default or empty states.
